label: def:observable-mtc
title: Observable modular tensor category at $q = \zeta_N$
html:
Fix an integer N \geq 3 and set q = \zeta_N = e^{2\pi i / N}, a primitive N-th root of unity. At this value the representation category \mathrm{Rep}(U_q(\mathfrak{su}_2)) is no longer semisimple; quotienting out the ideal of negligible morphisms yields the truncated category \mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{any}}(N), with finitely many simple objects \mathbf{V}_0, \mathbf{V}_1, \ldots, \mathbf{V}_{N-2} [moore-seiberg1989].

The observable modular tensor category at level N is the ribbon fusion category \mathbf{C}_{\mathrm{any}}(N), equipped with the braiding c and ribbon twist \varTheta inherited from the quasi-triangular structure of U_q(\mathfrak{su}_2) at q = \zeta_N. It is modular: the S-matrix S_{ij} = \mathrm{tr}(c_{\mathbf{V}_i, \mathbf{V}_j} \circ c_{\mathbf{V}_j, \mathbf{V}_i}) is non-degenerate.
